question: Which country won the Men's Asia Cup 2022 for cricket?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Option 1**__. 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• In Cricket, Sri Lanka defeated Pakistan by 23 runs to lift their 6th Asia Cup title at the Dubai International Stadium on 11 Sept 2022.
 
• Sri Lanka posted 170 runs for the loss of six wickets in 20 overs.
 
• Sri Lanka all-rounder Wanindu Hasaranga has been adjudged the Player of the Series while Bhanuka Rajapaksa has been named the Player of the Match for his batting performance in the final.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The 2022 Asia Cup was the 15th edition of the Asia Cup cricket tournament.
 
• The matches were played as Twenty20 Internationals (T20Is) during August and September 2022 in the United Arab Emirates.
 
• Originally scheduled to be held in September 2020, the tournament was postponed in July 2020 due to the COVID-19 pandemic.
